content:
Then in turn lord Agamemnon, king of men, answered him:

“Son of Laertes, I rejoice to have heard your speech;  
for you have set forth and recounted everything in proper measure.  
These things I myself am willing to swear to—my heart urges me—  
and I will not swear falsely before the god. But let Achilles  
remain there for the moment, eager though he is for battle;  
and let all the rest of you stay assembled, until the gifts  
come from my hut and we make the faithful oaths.

And to you yourself I give this charge and command:  
choose the best young men from all the Achaeans  
to bring the gifts from beside my ship, all that we promised yesterday  
to give Achilles, and to bring the women too.  
And let Talthybius quickly, throughout the broad camp of the Achaeans,  
prepare a boar for me to sacrifice to Zeus and to the Sun.”
